description: Browse the wiki by tag path rather than by keyword — every page under a branch, newest first by default. Returns the same rows as search_wiki (title, URL, tagPath, slug, snippet, updatedAt) plus a pagination envelope carrying totalPages, hasMore and nextPage. Omit tagPath to walk the whole wiki; pass one from get_categories to stay inside a branch. Sort by title for an A-Z pass.
name: list_pages
title: List pages
